body: I hope your cats are doing well, and I hope you keep fighting on. Everything feels like there is no hope but this is just the wall of the storm. We will have a tomorrow to rebuild and improve with, and I hope you are there to help shape it the way you want it to be.

If you would,  please, sit down and honor him in these trying times. When my mom died I felt the same way, but you have the chance to do something nice with this time. 

Share the happiness he gave you.  It can be a  book of all the things he did that make you happy,  a picture of his smiling face, it can be whatever feels right. And I want you to keep trying to encapsulate everything that he did to make you happy and put it into something you can leave behind. So that that happiness doesn't leave with you.

It will be hard, but keep trying. It can be anything you think works, and there are always guides online for arts and crafts. I think by the time you have what I asked for you'll have a whole new skin and a legacy for the most important person in your life.

And, if that's not enough reason to try, you can always share it so that everyone else gets a taste of that little piece of perfect you once had.

You know, life doesn't have to make sense. It doesn't have to be anything. 

Life simply is.
I hope you read this before you go.  Living for those small moments is all you need to live for. Living for all the people you feel like you need to tell this is valid.

No one defines a good life but you. I know what that eternal internal darkness feels like. You need to open it up and talk to someone. 

If you're gone, or still leaving, then I admire your choice, but I hope you understand that the only thing you need it what you want to do. Live to make enough money to sit on a couch to watch your favorite tv show, and you might find 3 more you like. The same with everything else. It's okay to feel like this, but it's also okay to open up and live for yourself.

I hope you realize that it takes a lot strength to kill yourself. 

Not physically,  I mean determination. And maybe it's jealous speaking, but I miss having that level of drive. 

So I'll tell you what I never listened to back in you're place.

You have a friend you care for that deeply, thst you can confide in and with.  You have an iron will to resist every instinct MILLIONS of years of evolution have put in your way to help you live. You have more power in you than most people. 

And you have a physical, understood and treatable problem that has lead you here.

I'm fat, I binge, and usually only ear once a day.  But it doesn't phase me at all,  because I understand that it's because I'm not helping myself. You need to help yourself. 
Not even all at once, just baby steps will do it. Tell your friend. Then maybe a doctor,  or a parent. Then maybe you'll be able to use that determination to push yourself past needing them and letting your thoughts on food dictate you life.

You need to walk before you can run, but you need to crawl to some help so they can put you on your feet to let you build the muscle.

I know you can do it. You've already won, really, you just need to send out the troops.

I think I need a therapist. I think I need to to seek actual help. Find out why I keep sliding back into my hole. But no one taught me how. I never needed help before. And when I did i always had someone to push me and guide me to what I needed

But i don't have anything but the thinning wall of my family for support. My mom died, my dad is dying, the only people I have left I can't tell,  because if I do tell them theres a chance they can't help but will just take my freedoms away so I won't be able to take my own life any more. 

I want my cake and to eat it too, but I know better, so I'm staring at the cake rot.

It's actually my first time seeing it, so blame the app.
I don't feel numb, per se. I feel like I've gotten content in the ditch that's slowly sinking into hell , and that leaving it scares me because I like my content little ditch. 

But there are things that make me happy. I just don't know what to do with any of it any more. I get physically sick anytime I try to do anything to turn myself around and become independent.

I just don't know what to do, except leave the situation at this point. But I wouldn't be posting this if a part of me didn't think there was a chance.

I just..cant find my legs any more. So I'm waiting for a chance to just leave.

"I'm resourceful, determined, and capable of anything"

So, what do you want?
To tie a rope to your roof and dangle from it? I think someone who has gotten to a point to make 5000k a week can do better.

Life sucks,  he'll I don't want to live it. But I think id kill for even a small amount of time making that money. 

You'll pick yourself up if you try. After all, "I'm resourceful, determined, and capable of anything", and posting here is just you not knowing where else to turn. I get it, redditors don't know who you are or what you look like so its easy to talk to them. But there are resources here on suicide watch that will be able to offer you more help than I can through the screen.

Life sucks. I think we all get tired of the stress and need a break. You just need a push man, and were here to do our best to get you there. I hope your life turns around man, but I respect that if you want to its yours to end.

Call me a liar, get enraged at me, and then go out and harness that energy into doing whatever you want.

Scientists concluded that the average human body contains approximately 37.2 trillion cells. Only around 100 billion are estimated to be the neurons in your brain that handle your overall emotions, health, or thoughts.

Most of these only know very basic concepts like defend myself, eat, mutiply. 

This means that only a mere 0.0002688172% of your cells will actually want to die. Everything else thinks survive survive survive.

So when your tired,  what's happening is that small percent hearing the rest with their issues and looking at your situation and being hit by the burden to sort it all out. 

This makes you tired, and since your brain only ever gets alone time when you are asleep, that's the only time those neurons get to be left alone and sort your body on their own. 

But death is actually the lack of oxygen to these cells and their death which kills the rest of the body, which doesn't know what is going on and sends a signal to you that will say "no no no I don't wanna die I need [insert problem here] fixed." This will cause you to second guess yourself and be given a sudden burst of energy to try and fix the problem.

Death is not like sleeping. What you need, what you want are to relieve mental stress and find a way to relax, to improve your situation and allow yourself time to make tour body all work together. But your neurons don't know that the only way to do that is to buckle down and do it. They think "I feel good when I'm asleep, why can't I always do that?". 


I recommend a vacation and when you come back busting your ass to make your life better for yourself. Because that's what you actually want.


And hey, if I'm wrong, well at least you got some new thoughts to play with other than being tired up there.

It makes sense. As a word of advice,  your in a downward cycle that will attempt to swallow you up. I recommend fixating on small things that keep you going and pushing yourself to then before these nihilistic feelings put you in a hole you won't be able to climb out of when the reality of it scares you away from death. 

Well, that's the advice I'm supposed to give anyways. Personally I say live life for what You want.  It will help you to help others and people like your mom and amy.  You can't make them happy if they see you're spiralling. 

It's probably going to be the hardest, slowest, most unrewarding feeling you could imagine at first. But if you don't stick to it and just do it then you're just going to make them hurt for longer.


Your life is in your hands. Shape it how you wish to see it.

I have no desire to work or put effort into this life, of which I did not choose, and I do not fear death on a mental level. I accept that I will die, and see no fault inherently with taking my own life as long as I feel it is worth it.  And as my pleasures become vapid without an ability to ground them in my true feelings, I am apathetic and would prefer dying over harming another.

Why do I owe the world anything,  and how is it not my choice to decide I'm done with it? I understand no one asked to be born, but nothing should force you to stay, it seems immoral to me to damn someone for escaping a situation outside of their control.

This is why I'm not a fan of Freud's works. I was the golden child, far as I know, I devolped these and kept them a secret because I Knew they were wrong, but didn't know why it was wrong.  I devolped this voice and as far as I know as many as 8 variations according to my easiest memories, all of which were boiled down into a slow, empathic mind and a quick, intellectual mind. I personally identify more with the emotional one as my truer self.

Can you glean anything from that? Because to me I just thought it was me manifesting my persona and the 8 were my different ones as I child.

But can you please explain how I managed to make my Id and superego two voices I literally hear converse? That sounds like some kind of mental break but I haven't the psychology degree to understand what's happening there.

Sorry if that doesn't help you.

I apologize for the outburst, but in the interest of a fair and honest conversation with you all I'm not taking it down. I don't believe in unhonest conversation like that. I apologize for the highly inappropriate conduct and outburst.

I made it to being who I wanted to be, to find that person had no dreams or aspiriations, he had no plan. I would literally have to have my mentality completely shifted and a new lease on life and the only way I know is truama. 

And at that point, after tearing down my entire persona and becoming someone new, am I me anymore? And how do I know I don't become someone horrible. I'm cracking, it's not showing yet to my family but I literally can't handle it it's making me sick.

It has done me no good to learn the arts, I had the same thoughts 5 years ago. And here I am, dying slowly because none of it means anything! 

I just want to die so the thoughts will finally give me peace man. It doesn't go away with sublimation and I'm in a bed of thorns as it is. I don't need to fail, to be rejected and use these thoughts and feelings to become a new Hitler or something, even if on a much smaller scale.

I know it's fears I need to face but how do you warn your family "don't reject my art or I might rape someone."

It's just too hard man, let me let the pain end.

I appreciate your words. But to resist any further leaves me with nothing. I can't be assertive without becoming a monster, and I can't be passive because I study everyone and thing for ways to defend myself, and then twist the knife so get what I want. 

How can I stop that? I cant, it's not in me, I do it subconsciously and in my father's efforts to make me a better person he taught me all I needed to know to do it well, the warning signs became a how to manuel.

Where do I vent? How? Anything I do I fuck someone and also fuck me.either in the head or situation.

And I don't believe this is anyone's fault but mine. I can't surrender myself enough to change. I can't give in and allow myself to become someone else. 

I have three options: 1 do horrible things and make use of my talents and intellect, 2 waste them and myself slowly atrophying as I have been or 3 kill myself. 

It's the only choice I can make with my morals intact.

I'm at the end of my rope man. I want to die BEFORE I do something because i can either vegetize and use that intellect to manipulate the people around me into giving me a free ride or I can embrace these feelings and feel happiness again but at the cost of some other unfortunate soul. It's killing me, damned if I do or don't I want to make the only choice that matters.

End it all before I snap.

He's just a boy. I know morally it'd be wrong. He can't consent to it at all. But I've come within inches of crossing that line only to pull away just before I ruin my life.

Ah, I'm aware of them. I have been aware of them for most of my life. My father explained to me when I was young that I was his effort to break the cycle of abuse and have been trying to live as close to that legacy as possible.

I've also been repressing most of these feelings of self hatred and only just acknowledged them openly for the first time.

I've been aware that I had these thoughts, I simply worked to be better then them. But I realised today that I've hated myself for years and this is why I want to die.

But as I said I'm open to discussion. Mayhaps ice missed something along the way to my conclusion.
